title: Table 9.1 sets out the common and IUPAC names of twelve alkylamines and arylamines.
note: A nomenclature table, not a reaction: each row pairs one structure with its common name and its IUPAC name, given here as 'common / IUPAC'.
unreadable: AUDIT 2026-10-22: the card DREW all twelve amines as skeleton structures. Those eight are now text, written as printed, with their two names after a middot.
